description: Run Python on a runner in an execute session (the code runs on the runner's machine, sandboxed, under the session's limits). Name it with a descriptive `filename`. Waits for the signed result by default. Files the job writes to $AIRLOX_OUT come back as out files: small text files inline in out_text; use get_result with save_dir to save them all. result.env, signed by the runner (not written by the job), says where it ran: Python version, installed versions of the allowlisted packages, sandbox and interpreter source.

filename.description:
A short name saying what the code does, e.g. "summarize_sales.py":
it is how people and the audit trail tell jobs apart (default
main.py).

files.description: Ids of file items to give the job (ZIPs are unpacked in its directory).

labels.description: Run on any runner with a free slot that has all of these labels.

memory_mb.description: Job memory limit in MB (default: the session's).

progress_file.description:
A file in the job's work dir or $AIRLOX_OUT, such as a log, whose
last lines the runner reports while the job runs.

requirements.description: Packages from the session's allowlist the job needs.

runner.description: Run on this runner (name or key). Leave out for any approved runner with a free slot.

timeout_s.description: Job time limit in seconds (default: the session's).

wait_s.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the result (default 120, max 600; 0 to return at once).

name: run_python
